archetypes.name: stream-contract
archetypes.rationale: The fix depends on stderr-only warnings while stdout remains KV-only.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the write-tally stream contracts. Confirm ignored code-review header warnings cannot contaminate stdout, fatal header-read errors still fail, and run-log KV re-emission remains parseable. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: round-tally-regression
archetypes.rationale: The regression is a multi-round cumulative rewrite failure.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the flush_review_batches regression path. Focus on whether the test exercises _build_tally_body plus write-tally, proves round 2 rewrites the tally, and verifies cumulative accepted and rejected counts come from review-findings-full.jsonl. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
